author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
In the stop-motion puppet collection of the Cinema Relics archive, Adam reconnects with former colleague Martin Meunier, whose work on Laika's Coraline was groundbreaking for stop-motion animation. Taking a look at a few puppets from Coraline, Martin explains how he developed the facial animation system to make use of rapid prototyping, a process which earned him and the team an Academy Award. 

Learn more about Cinema Relics prop investigations at: https://www.youtube.com/@cinemarelics/videos
Cinema Relics Investigates: The Coraline Puppet Controversy: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=szfp6praymU
Anthony Scott on Coraline, Nightmare Before Christmas & the Future of Stop-Motion: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zMnxWPtU3Ik

Shot by Joey Fameli and edited by Norman Chan
